title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
brief: Carry out compatible PostgreSQL schema and index changes with bounded waits and complete acceptance.
outcomes: Choose native operations from their lock and rewrite behaviour
Validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes safely
entry: General schema-change protocol, PostgreSQL indexes and locking.

title: Operating and diagnosing PostgreSQL
brief: Use PostgreSQL evidence to separate blocked work, excessive work and connection pressure.
outcomes: Trace a request through pool and server waits
Test a targeted operational intervention and its recovery cost
entry: General incident triage and a PostgreSQL application connection; prepare native plans or vacuum only for the selected investigation.

neighbours.RL113: Supplies native plan interpretation before an execution/spill repair.
neighbours.RL111: Supplies vacuum and retained-horizon understanding before maintenance changes.
neighbours.RL91: Supplies any missing lock/wait reasoning before a blocker intervention.

title: PostgreSQL roles, policies and privileged code
brief: Test PostgreSQL privilege and row-policy boundaries as the actual application roles.
outcomes: Explain role inheritance, ownership and policy bypass
Secure privileged routines against identity and name-resolution mistakes
entry: General least privilege and tenant boundaries (RL104), including application connection ownership. The needed secure deployment, SQL object names and session identity are introduced locally.

title: Where distributed PostgreSQL work runs
brief: Choose where PostgreSQL-distributed work runs from co-location, constraint scope and movement requirements.
outcomes: Distinguish native partitions, application shards, Citus and foreign tables
Derive local work, skew and a safe ownership transfer
entry: General sharding, distributed transactions and PostgreSQL architecture.

title: Full-text search in PostgreSQL
brief: Build PostgreSQL text retrieval from linguistic matching through ranked, filtered results.
outcomes: Derive token, phrase and ranking behaviour from a configuration
Keep index retrieval and relevance evaluation distinct
entry: PostgreSQL operators/index methods and query result semantics.

title: Vector search in PostgreSQL
brief: Evaluate PostgreSQL vector retrieval independently from the meaning assigned by an embedding model.
outcomes: Distinguish semantic relevance from nearest-neighbour recall
Choose exact, HNSW or IVFFlat retrieval under filters and lifecycle cost
entry: PostgreSQL indexes, plan measurement and filtered result semantics.
